transcript: I just competed against AI to buy an iPhone and humans got destroyed. I was at GFF in Mumbai at the Pine Labs booth where they had this crazy live product experience called Humans vs Agents. And the deal was crazy. GFF attendees could get iPhone 17 or the AirPods Gen 3 delivered to them at 40% discount using Mastercard with the BigBasket's beta app and get them delivered at GFF the same day. There was only 5 minutes to checkout. Some were manually trying to buy them while others had set up AI agents to shop for them. And when the 5 minutes were over, agents were authorized to buy 80% of the stock. Only 20% went to humans who tried manually. And this wasn't just a cool AI demo. Pine Labs actually put agentic checkout in front of real consumers at GFF enabled by P3P, their own payments protocol. Today I watched AI beat humans at checkout. Maybe the future of shopping is humans not shopping at all. What do you think? Let me know below and follow for more.
caption:
AI just beat humans 🤯

I got to experience Pine Labs’ Humans vs Agents at GFF, and it made “agentic commerce” feel a lot less like a buzzword and a lot more like something that’s already happening.
